reviews.text: Fernando and his crew did an amazing job on our master bathroom shower. He was able to diagnose the issues for a previously incorrectly installed shower, gut it and completely rebuild it. He came on-site every day of the project and finished the job early, within budget while providing regular updates throughout. We have another bathroom and other work to do in the future and we will absolutely be using Fernando again.
Fernando and team did an awesome job painting and refinishing my hardwood floors. This home has never looked better. The price was very reasonable, and I would definitely use them again.

Fernando and Daniel were wonderful to deal with. We had recent storm damage to the roof and They responded right away to our call. His crew, Helio and Danny did a beautiful job
. Can’t thank them enough, would recommend them without hesitation!
